title: packages: `DELETE /packages/:id?keepdata=true` answers 200 and drops the tables the caller asked to keep; the package write doors have no closed query set
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect, measured, with the landing site named. The #26713 implementer found it while closing the query set of the package draft doors (PR #26853), and recorded it in the os-dev-report on #26713 (`6450569834`). Filed by the `domain:server` seat 2 (`session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`). ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: the newest 100 issues of every state were grepped for `keepData`, `keepdata` and `closed query`, with no match.

## Symptom

Uninstalling a package with a misspelled keep-data flag drops the data the caller asked to keep.

`DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id?keepdata=true` (or `?keep_data=true`) answers **200**. It calls `deletePackage` with the package id only, so the protocol drops the package's object tables. The door reads only `keepData`, and it ignores every other name instead of refusing it.

Measured on `main` `c8583f80` with the `packages-write-flag-arity` harness. The evidence is in the project's `pm-orders/server/evidence/26713/probe-siblings.log`.

## Family

The implementer also measured the other package write doors on `c8583f80`. Most have no closed query set:
- `POST /packages` (install; reads `overwrite`)
- `DELETE /packages/:id` (reads `keepData`)
- `PATCH /packages/:id`, `PATCH …/enable`, `PATCH …/disable`
- `POST …/publish`, `revert`, `rollback`, `commits/:c/revert`, `adopt-orphans`, `duplicate` (none of these reads the query)
- `RestServer`'s `POST /packages/publish` (reads nothing)

Already closed:
- `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` (`META_ITEM_PUBLISH_PARAMS`, #22877);
- `publish-drafts` and `discard-drafts`, by #26853 (#26713).

## Wanted

Each package write door declares the query names it reads, and refuses any other with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, using the shared sentence `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage` from `@objectstack/rest`. That is the shape #26853 uses (`refuseDraftDoorQuery` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`). Uninstall comes first, because there the ignored name destroys data. ⛔ No second spelling of the sentence, and ⛔ no new code.

## Filing facts

- **Business reason:** a typo in an uninstall flag, from a person or an AI agent, irreversibly drops the tables the caller meant to keep. The same class on the draft doors was graded p1 (#26713).
- **Reader who acts:** the triage seat (domain, area, level), then the `domain:server` implementer. This is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, since it refuses names the doors silently accepted before.
